messages:
Lena (Sales): Handoff for Valeon Labs — closed last Friday. They want a 3-month Dedicated pilot, private peering into their VPC, and HSM-backed key management for compliance (SOC2 + GDPR). Main use: reranking + short-context chat, expect steady 4k req/day with short spikes to 15k for promo periods. Procurement asked for a conservative monthly run-rate and a pilot success criteria doc. Can CS/SE/Support sync Thu 10am PT? I uploaded sales notes and anonymized sample to vault: https://1password.example/sales/valeon.

Caleb (CS): I'll take onboarding & weekly enablement. Thu 10am PT works. I'll open a ticket and draft a runbook template that includes timeline, owners, enablement cadence, and a feedback capture form for early quality signals. Lena, please share primary technical contacts + any procurement constraints.

Mina (Solutions Eng): Mina here  — I'll validate reranker model compatibility, advise on quant/batching for cost, and run a throughput bench against their sample inputs. Lena, can you paste the typical request payload (avg tokens, rerank list size)? If they can run our bench script that helps: ```bash
curl -X POST https://bench.redwood.internal/run -d '{"model":"rerank-large","seq":128,"requests":500}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```

Omar (Support): I'll prepare the private peering and HSM notes (allowed egress, port requirements, certs, KMS integration steps). Tagging infra-oncall for network setup. Also will add a step to the runbook for a short smoke test during provisioning window.

deploy-bot: Ticket created CS-5122 for Valeon Labs onboarding (assigned to Caleb) https://tickets.redwood/cs/5122

Caleb (CS): Owners: Lena = sales liaison, Caleb = CS onboarding lead (CS-5122), Mina = SE (rerank/perf), Omar = Support/ops. Next steps on ticket: 1) Lena share tech contacts + sample payload; 2) Mina run perf bench and recommend quant/profile; 3) Omar publish peering/HSM preflight checklist; 4) Caleb schedule weekly enablement and publish pilot success criteria (latency targets, error rate threshold, cost per 1M tokens). I'll invite Thu 10am PT now.

Lena (Sales): Shared contacts and sample payloads in vault. Procurement note: they require line-item pilot pricing (compute, storage, egress), and want a predefined rollback plan if costs exceed threshold. Renewal risk: flagged medium-high if pilot ROI unclear.

Mina (Solutions Eng): Running bench now. Initial results: p50 latency ~210ms for rerank route, end-to-end streaming degraded with batch>12. Recommending batch size 8 for rerank, enable prefix caching for repeated contexts, and 8-bit quant for non-critical routes to save ~30% CPU. Will attach full bench to CS-5122 by EOD.

Omar (Support): Preflight checklist posted: allowlist 3.120.45.9/32 and 3.120.45.10/32, ports 443 and 22 for admin, HSM integration notes added. I'll request provisioning window for next Tue.

Caleb (CS): I'll draft the pilot success criteria: 1) p50 latency <= 300ms for core rerank route, 2) error rate < 0.5% sustained, 3) monthly cost <= procurement threshold (TBD), 4) customer feedback score >= 4/5 during trial. I'll publish and request procurement's threshold to plug into the deck. Also will include a short feedback capture form (post-enable survey + weekly CS check-ins).

Lena (Sales): Procurement threshold shared privately. I'll DM Caleb. Also note: legal needs to sign a DPA + KMS addendum before HSM keys are provisioned.

legal-bot: DPA + KMS addendum request logged LEG-3310 and linked to CS-5122. Notifying Legal.

Mina (Solutions Eng): Adding recommended fallback plan: lower-capacity model for peak windows + token-shed policy per route. Will include per-route cost estimates for deck.

Omar (Support): Provisioning window requested on CS-5122. Infra-oncall looped in for network validation.

Caleb (CS): Invite sent for Thu 10am PT; ticket updated with owners and next steps. I'll run weekly enablement starting Week 0 and capture any product-quality feedback in the runbook. If legal/procurement or infra blockers appear, flag here. :thumbsup: 

Lena (Sales): Thanks team  I'll join the Thu call and bring procurement + technical lead.

Mina (Solutions Eng): +1

Omar (Support): +1

Caleb (CS): Closing loop for now  ticket CS-5122 updated, owners assigned, feedback form attached.
